stories.title: LeBron James Will Live in NYC, Commute to Philadelphia — 76ers Era on His Terms

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
LeBron James is signing with the 76ers — and living in New York City.

He'll commute to Philadelphia for practices and games.

No press conference. No local home. No "Welcome to Philly" parade.

LeBron in his 24th season is doing this entirely on his own terms. 👑

#76ers #NBA

76ers 2026-27 starting five:

Maxey. Edgecombe. Jaylen Brown. LeBron. Embiid.

That's 5 MVP awards on the floor at once.

And their best player lives in another city. 😅

Basketball is wild. 🏀

#76ers #NBA

stories.title: Kawhi Leonard Investigation — NBPA Arbitration Threat Extends Case Toward 2027

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The Kawhi Leonard investigation could last into 2027.

If the NBPA demands arbitration, the case goes to a neutral arbiter — with no hard deadline.

Commissioner Silver said it must end before the season.

That deadline is now in serious doubt. 🕐

#LAClippers #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Toronto agreed to trade for Kawhi Leonard on June 30.

It's August 3. The trade is still frozen.

The Raptors can't plan. The Clippers can't move on. Kawhi's future is in limbo.

NBPA arbitration could make this a 2026-27 season storyline.

#Raptors #LAClippers
